name: 缝线皮衣
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one isolated modular 2D game torso texture, intended to replace body.png on an existing Spine bone. Image 1 is the ONLY EDIT TARGET: enlarged original disconnected torso part with its original transparent padding. Image 2 is context reference showing how the original part sits in a character; DO NOT redraw the character from image 2. Make a subtle reusable leather-clothing variant: keep the burgundy outer vest edges, shoulder slope, collar opening, crossing belt, waist boundary and lower skin-colored junction exactly where they are; change only the central blue-gray fabric panel to muted chestnut leather with two simple visible stitched seams and one small worn brass buckle. Preserve original torso shape, three-quarter left-facing angle, cut-off joint boundaries, lighting and modern colorful cartoon fantasy sprite style. Keep the warm leather moderately light so it remains readable at tiny size. Avoid elaborate engraving or noise. The edited fragment must remain only a torso fragment with NO head, NO face, NO neck extension, NO arms, NO hands, NO legs, NO weapon, NO full character. Preserve source silhouette and source placement as tightly as possible; do not rotate, recenter or enlarge the object. Transparent background, genuine alpha, no checkerboard, no colored backdrop, no text, no border, no glow, no detached accessories. Return the single edited body fragment, not a sheet or comparison.

normalization.operation: Technical alpha-bound crop, resample and restore original canvas only; no painted edits
